material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: jettied upper storey, 10.6 x 10.6 m and 2.8 m high: close-studded dark timber frame with straight and curved braces over cream plaster, joist ends under the jetty, small leaded windows
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: Braces are laid on the plaster rather than framed into the posts; the curved braces are swept bars of even section. Opaque window panels. Rendered standing on the ground; in use it sits on the lower storey. One 4096 px bake covers the whole building, about 100 px/m: it holds at the gameplay camera and is soft at 1 m (a tiling masonry material with trim would be the engine-side answer). Walls are flat slabs with the coursing in the textures; the inside is a dark core, not a room. One convex hull is exported.
stacking: place at z = 3.0 m on SM_Snow_House_Lower_PR
